description: Decide which named consumers a GraphQL schema change affects. Each consumer declares the parts of the schema it depends on, as Type.field and Type.field(argument), and the response says per consumer whether it is affected and exactly which dependency broke. A declared dependency the previous schema does not define is reported as not compared, not as unaffected. A new required input field is reported once against the schema, since it affects every consumer sending that input. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later schema. GraphQL SDL, read as a documented subset: type, interface, union, enum, input and scalar definitions with arguments, wrappers and defaults. Type extensions and directive definitions are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

before.description: The earlier schema. GraphQL SDL, read as a documented subset: type, interface, union, enum, input and scalar definitions with arguments, wrappers and defaults. Type extensions and directive definitions are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

consumers.description: The consumers to judge. Each name must be distinct, or a finding cannot be attributed to one of them.

name: graphql_client_impact_audit

compatible.description: True only when every declared dependency was compared and none of them was affected.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consumers.description: Per consumer: how many dependencies it declared, how many were affected, which ones, and whether it is untouched.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: GraphQL Client Impact Audit
